title: Representation collapse risk for JEPAs
description: The paper acknowledges that Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures, like standard Joint-Embedding Architectures, are susceptible to representation collapse. The method relies on an asymmetric architecture between context and target encoders to mitigate this risk.
canonical_description: joint-embedding predictive architectures susceptible to representation collapse

evidence.quote: However, as with Joint-Embedding Architectures, representation collapse is also a concern with JEPAs; we leverage an asymmetric architecture between the $\vx$- and $\vy$-encoders to avoid representation collapse.
